name: The Hyderabad Table
intro: A signature Asli Hyderabad dining experience hosted at exceptional restaurants, heritage settings and interesting spaces across the city. Every edition brings together a place, a menu, a story and interesting people around one table. One edition could explore Deccani cuisine, another contemporary Telugu food, another the city’s Nizam heritage, and another Hyderabad through the eyes of a chef, artist, entrepreneur or cultural voice.
